tied_with.note: Wrong or incomplete tool order; submit never confirmed. Newly visible without sequence coaching.

next_pilot_failure_to_check.rationale: On the realistic test, failures split 2/2 between a post-submit tool-call final (v0-g102, v2-g102) and an unconfirmed submit from disordered tools (v1-g101, v1-g102). Prefer final_answer_tool_call_after_submit for the next limited pilot: it matches the Track 3 claim (stop and confirm only after successful submit), already appeared as the sole residual on the coached 5.5 matrix (15/16), and here still occurs even when the four-tool sequence completed. Train on separate paraphrases u0–u3; keep this test fixed.
